She tells me that it's different and I can't figure out how so I point out how I've finished food she couldn't before and she's no stranger to my germs. She said all of that's different, sharing food with anyone is disgusting. I pointed out that she's shared food with her mom before but again "that's different and I need to just drop it because I clearly don't understand how bacteria works" I do understand. I know that whatever viruses or bacteria I may have was spread to her when I kissed her seconds before I got the pizza out of the oven. I mean I felt like she called me disgusting and wanted clarification.
